description: This file contains platform-specific functions for upgrading firmware on various hardware devices within the OpenWrt project. It defines functions for checking images, performing upgrades, and handling device-specific upgrade procedures based on the device's board name.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the firmware image is compatible with the device's board based on a magic number.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs firmware upgrade procedures tailored to specific device models identified by their board name.
